resource.description: Send any x402 resource URL, get a trust verdict on the endpoint itself. Returns TRUSTED / CAUTION / AVOID with a 0-100 score from an observation-only live probe (never pays the target): payment terms, Bazaar discovery-schema quality, CDP Bazaar and PayAI catalog presence, plus a diff against the previous check. Use this when an agent is about to pay an unfamiliar x402 endpoint and needs to know it is alive, honestly described, and unchanged first.

resource.description: Probe one x402 resource or page WITHOUT paying it: BASELINE / UNCHANGED / CHANGED with a diff (price, asset, payTo, schema, body) vs the last check. Use this when a scheduled agent must know what changed first. Watch and pack state persist across redeploys on the service volume. Checking the same endpoint on a schedule? Buy the pack instead — POST /v1/recheck/pack is $1 for 250 checks (90 days) and this route spends pack credits when you send pack_id, so a loop makes one payment, not hundreds.

example.summary: Changed since the previous check: amount.
